clue.text: Craving for a little French pea soup

indicators.note: soup is a mixture of stirred ingredients, so the letters before it are blended into a new order

parts.note: petit is French for little or small

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a small bowl of French pea soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soup' mixes PETIT (French for 'little') with PEA, giving the eight letters of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A craving is a strong desire, especially hunger for food.

clue.text: Fury, when beer can tips over starters

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer

indicators.note: starters are the opening items, so take the first letter of each of the preceding words

explanation.surface: Someone flies into a rage when a can of beer is knocked over before the first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'starters' takes the first letters of 'can tips over', giving CTO after ALE. 'Fury' with a capital is one of the three Furies of Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: Alecto is one of the three Erinyes, the avenging goddesses of Greek mythology.

clue.text: Common plover — small variety, flying up from inside mine

indicators.note: inside places one piece within the word for mine

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

indicators.note: in a down clue, flying up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: something of a small variety is wee, Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A common bird, a small one, flies up out of a mineshaft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying up' turns WEE into EEW, which goes 'inside' PIT.
explanation.definitionFit: The peewit, or lapwing, is a common plover named for its call.

clue.text: Convey powerful emotion

definitions.meaning: to carry or move goods or people from place to place
a rapture or overwhelming feeling, as in a fit of joy

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means carry from place to place; the noun means being carried away by strong feeling.

clue.text: Complete meal on the way

parts.note: thorough means complete or utter
fare is food, the meal served

explanation.surface: Someone has a full dinner while travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoroughfare is a main road or public route.

clue.text: Underwear lawyers need

definitions.meaning: barristers are instructed through written case summaries

explanation.definitionFit: The word means short underpants and also the written instructions a barrister receives.

clue.text: Relationship of a trio

indicators.note: of here means made out of, so the answer is formed from the letters of the next words

explanation.surface: The bond between three people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' is a thin anagram signal meaning 'made from': A TRIO rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is the proportional relation between two quantities.

clue.text: It's clear the way out is round the hairpin bend

indicators.note: is round says the exit word encircles the other piece

parts.note: an exit is the way out

indicators.note: to bend something is to twist it out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a hair clip is a pin for the hair

explanation.surface: A road sign makes it plain that the exit is past the hairpin bend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bend' rearranges CLIP into PLIC, and 'is round' puts EXIT around it. 'hairpin bend' reads as a sharp turn in a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Explicit means stated clearly and fully, leaving nothing implied.

clue.text: Having an inclination towards strong drink, worker admitted

indicators.note: admitted means let in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sling is a spirit-based mixed drink, as in gin sling
the worker ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: Someone inclined to drink heavily is let into the workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: Something slanting is sloping or tilted to one side.

clue.text: A lever to shift, then lift

indicators.note: to shift is to move things about, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Moving a lever to start a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevator is the American word for a passenger lift.

clue.text: More work? The perfect place for it

definitions.meaning: the 1516 book by Sir Thomas More

explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More's book named an ideal island, and the word now means any ideal society.

clue.text: The spectacles rejected by pessimists?

parts.note: optimists are said to see the world through glasses tinted a pinkish hue; pessimists refuse to wear them

explanation.definitionFit: Seeing through tinted glasses is an idiom for an overly hopeful view, which gloomy people lack.

clue.text: Journeys by jet, returning

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: spirt is an old spelling of spurt, a jet of liquid

explanation.surface: Flights made by jet aircraft, coming home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns SPIRT backwards. SPIRT is an old spelling of 'spurt'.
explanation.definitionFit: Trips are journeys or excursions.

clue.text: Study a relief, he's found

parts.note: a relief is a landform map; the person who studies the relief of mountains is a scientist of heights

explanation.definitionFit: An orologist is a scientist who studies mountains, the relief of the land.

clue.text: Churchgoers got nice organ overhauled

indicators.note: overhauled means taken apart and rebuilt, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Worshippers find the church organ has been nicely repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: A congregation is the body of people at a church service.

clue.text: Share a growing concern

definitions.meaning: a rented plot where vegetables are grown, playing on the business phrase going concern

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a portion allotted and also a rented garden plot, a British institution for growing vegetables.

clue.text: Concerning motor-bike race -— only half turned up frequently

parts.note: of can mean about or concerning, as in tales of heroes
the TT, or Tourist Trophy, is the Isle of Man motorcycle race

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read upward, so the word is reversed

parts.note: semi- is the prefix meaning half

explanation.surface: Something about a motorcycle race where only half the field showed up, often.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses SEMI to IMES; 'only' is a link. The TT is the Isle of Man motorcycle race.
explanation.definitionFit: Ofttimes is an archaic word for often.

clue.text: A cistern replaced in a box

indicators.note: replaced means put back in a different place, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A water tank is swapped for one in a crate.
explanation.definitionFit: A canister is a small container, such as a tea caddy or tin.

clue.text: Loose off fast volley to celebrate mediaeval festival

indicators.note: a volley is a scattered burst of shots, so the letters are sent off in a new order

explanation.surface: Firing a quick round of shots to mark a medieval holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'volley' scatters LOOSE OFF FAST; 'to celebrate' links.
explanation.definitionFit: The Feast of Fools was a medieval New Year festivity in which clergy mocked church ritual.

clue.text: Cut out tax on home commodities!

definitions.meaning: to remove surgically or edit away
a duty charged on goods made in the country, such as alcohol

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means remove by cutting; the noun is a duty on domestically produced goods.

clue.text: Giving praise and as an afterthought, charitable donation

parts.note: PS, postscript, is added to a letter as an afterthought
alms are money or food given to the poor

explanation.surface: Praising God and then adding a gift to charity.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalms are sacred songs of worship from the Bible, sung in praise.

clue.text: Until that time on Thursday the riot developed

indicators.note: developed means grew into something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A riot broke out on Thursday; it had been quiet till then.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto's twin means up to that point in the past.

clue.text: City from which a noise escalates

indicators.note: from says the answer is taken out of the run of letters in the following words

explanation.surface: A city where the noise level is rising.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital is buried in 'whicH A NOIse'; 'escalates' is surface padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanoi is the capital city of Vietnam.

clue.text: Can be hired though a duty is put on

parts.note: a tax is a duty imposed by government

explanation.surface: A service may be rented out, though a levy is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Taxis are cabs that are hired for journeys.

clue.text: Praying rug, in south

parts.note: a mat is a small rug

explanation.surface: Someone at prayer on a rug in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: Matins is the morning prayer service of the church.

clue.text: Decision without coercion to become familiar with the bard?

parts.note: to make free with someone is to take liberties, becoming over-familiar
the Bard is Shakespeare, first name William, so Will

explanation.surface: Choosing of one's own accord to get to know Shakespeare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make free with' means treat too familiarly; 'the bard' is Shakespeare, Will.
explanation.definitionFit: Choice made without compulsion is the very idea of acting by one's own volition.

clue.text: Air filter

definitions.meaning: to sieve or pass through a colander

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a musical melody and also to sieve a liquid.

clue.text: Head of production desires time off

indicators.note: off means out of order or awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The production boss wants time away from work.
explanation.definitionFit: An editress is a woman who edits, heading a publication.
